Weight Change Tracking of NEt-3IB (1)   Dried  NEt3IB (1, 3.56 g, 1.0 mmol) was accurately weighed into a glass  bottle,  sealed  with  ﬁlter  paper,  and  stored  in  a  desiccator.
The weight of the container was measured at 10 a.m., and the  weight change of NEt-3IB (1) was measured by subtracting the  tare weight.
